arc_summary: This edit captures the journey from gentle nostalgia to exuberant celebration and back to tender reflection, mirroring the musical arc. I'll use diverse authentic moments of play and connection, starting with establishing shots of anticipation, building through joyful interactions, peaking with energetic climaxes at the loudest musical moments, and resolving with intimate, peaceful scenes that echo the opening warmth.

cuts.purpose: Establishing shot - children in decorated hallway sets nostalgic, peaceful tone
Gentle circular motion introduces playful anticipation with warmth
Initial hug and movement - joyful connection builds energy
Group organizing into circle - playful anticipation grows
Consistent jumping on trampoline - moderate energy builds excitement
Rhythmic dancing - sustained interaction builds toward peak
Peak clapping and singing - celebratory energy hits loudest musical moment
Peak chaotic movement and laughter - high energy matches strong beat
Children taking bow - celebratory climax with applause
Peak laughter during tickling - physical play at energetic high point
Child being lifted - joyful interaction transitions to softer energy
Children lying still looking at camera - peaceful resolution with loving warmth
